title: Tales cartoon pictures for small models

clauses.text: With a small local model, Tales draws a cartoon scene for each part of the story and the hero looks the same on each page.

steps.do: In Tales, choose a small local model as the writer and write a short story with pictures (for example a story about a fox).
steps.expect: Each page has a cartoon picture of the scene in its sentence, and the hero looks the same on every page. If a scene cannot be drawn, a plain sketch appears and the app says so in words.
